caption: Filtered notes with due, upcoming and invalid dates.
A due notice links to its note.
eval: const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('Date Property Alerts/Renew insurance.md'); await app.fileManager.processFrontMatter(f, fm => fm.due = new Date().toISOString()); 'ok'

caption: A free fifteen-minute snooze shows its wake time.
eval: const root = document.querySelector('.date-property-alerts'); const button = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent === 'Snooze 15 minutes'); if (!button) throw new Error('Missing snooze button'); button.click(); 'ok'

caption: Demo vault with Pro custom snooze controls and a wake time.
eval: const p = app.plugins.plugins['date-property-alerts']; p.qaOriginalHttp = p.pro.opts.http; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('date-property-alerts-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const root = document.querySelector('.date-property-alerts'); const input = root.querySelector('input[aria-label="Custom snooze minutes"]'); if (!input) throw new Error('Pro custom snooze missing'); input.value = '45'; Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent === 'Snooze custom').click(); 'demo Pro controls'
after: const p = app.plugins.plugins['date-property-alerts']; p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http = p.qaOriginalHttp; delete p.qaOriginalHttp; 'ok'

caption: Source guidance and optional Pro controls.
